title: limitations
snippet:
To protect the app from overload we impose some limits.
- Zendesk API calls per month dependent on your plan:
FREE - 25,000
REGULAR - 50,000
PLUS - 100,000
ENTERPRISE - 200,000
***Note:***
*1 assigned ticket = 1 API call*
*1 requested list of tickets from a view = from 1 to 15 API calls (100 tickets = 1 API call)*
*The out-of-office feature puts the comments = depends on the workflow (up to 1.5x or x2 or greater from the total number of assigned tickets)*
- The application will only read the first X tickets in the view:
FREE - 100 tickets
REGULAR - 200 tickets
PLUS - 500 tickets
ENTERPRISE - 1000 tickets
***Note:** the tickets with order number > X in the view will not be read by the app during **each** queue run, so some unassigned tickets (with order numbers in the view greater than X) will not be assigned. To avoid that, it is recommended to exclude already assigned tickets from the ticket source view. Or create a new Zendesk View that contains only unassigned tickets.*
- The "[Load balancing period](/hc/en-us/articles/115002909349-Fine-tuning)" feature has a limit of 168 hours (1 week) for all plans.

title: developer.zendesk.com/documentation/api-basics/getting-started/getting-a-trial-or-sponsored-account-for-development
snippet:
You can try out the Zendesk platform with a free, 14-day trial account. If you're interested in becoming a Zendesk developer partner, you can convert your trial account into a sponsored Zendesk Support account.
As part of becoming a Zendesk developer partner, Zendesk sponsors an instance for up to 5 agents that you can use for developing, demoing, and troubleshooting your app or integration.
Unlike a trial account, a sponsored account does not expire after 14 days.
By default, all Marketplace partners with a sponsored Support account receive the Suite Enterprise plan. A sponsored Sell account includes all features on the Sell Elite plan except the Firehouse, Sync, and Search APIs.

title: Is Zendesk Free? Trial, Startups Program and Cheapest Plan
snippet:
No. Zendesk has no free plan, and nothing stays free once the trial ends. What you get instead is a **14-day trial with no credit card**, usually on Suite Professional, for up to 5 people including you, plus one 14-day extension if your trial is eligible. Zendesk's pricing page lists the cheapest paid step, Support Team, at $19 per agent per month billed annually, or $25 billed monthly.[1] Billing is per agent, and every agent seat is paid; our [Zendesk pricing guide](/articles/zendesk-pricing) covers the renewal, refund and seat rules in full. The one longer free route is the startups program: six months for qualifying early-stage companies, longer only through partner VCs and accelerators. Plan the trial carefully. Two weeks go fast.

Developers get a free 14-day trial developer account, and Marketplace partners get a sponsored instance for up to 5 agents that does not expire. It is not a loophole.

| Plan | Billed annually | Billed monthly | What it adds |
|---|---|---|---|
| Support Team | $19 per agent per month | $25 per agent per month | Email ticketing, triggers, macros, views, public social |
| Suite Team | $55 per agent per month | $69 per agent per month | Messaging, live chat, voice, one help center in one language |
| Suite Professional | $115 per agent per month | $149 per agent per month | SLAs, skills routing, community, up to 5 help centers, 40+ languages |
| Suite Enterprise | Talk to Sales | Talk to Sales | Custom roles, audit logs, sandbox, approval workflows |

Qualifying startups get the most generous route: six months, longer only through partners, then a paid plan. Everyone else pays from $19 per agent per month billed annually, on a plan without a help center, so check which features you actually built before choosing.

title: Zendesk rate limits
snippet:
Zendesk Support API limits go by Suite plan: 200 requests a minute on Team, 400 on Growth and Professional, 700 on Enterprise, 2,500 on Enterprise Plus or with the High Volume add-on.

| What | Limit | Applies to |
|---|---|---|
| Support & Help Center API | 200 per minute | Suite Team |
| Support & Help Center API | 400 per minute | Growth, Professional |
| Support & Help Center API | 700 per minute | Enterprise |
| Support & Help Center API | 2,500 per minute | Enterprise Plus, or High Volume add-on |

Developer plan: free, 10,000 webhooks a month, no card, no end date.
